decision.section: Iterate - change: land the e2e-run-findings campaign brief
decision.title: The e2e-run-findings campaign brief and its report live on main
decision.context: The follow-up campaign to the first operator end-to-end run needs a brief BP can read: BP reads scope_frs from main, not from a worktree.
decision.decision: The campaign brief (units E1-E8, operator stops, scope_frs campaign-wide and per unit) and the findings report it builds on are committed under .shipwright/planning/campaigns/.
decision.consequences: BP can read scope_frs from main before the first unit runs; the campaign can start once the operator confirms the list and the admin-merge policy.
decision.rationale: A brief that exists only in a checkout cannot be read by BP or by a campaign runner started from a worktree.
decision.rejected: Committing by hand outside an iterate (planning docs go through an iterate).

changelog.bullet: Campaign brief for the e2e-run-findings follow-up (skill-backed app profile, kit-composed design, harness for the new app class, second end-to-end run) with the existing FRs it changes listed as scope_frs, plus the findings report it builds on
